title: Acquired Piezo2 Channelopathy is Not a Theory Anymore, but It is a True Saga
content: A significant bibliometric analysis of Piezo2 research put acquired Piezo2 channelopathy into the spotlight, however it claimed that it remains a hypothesis with the need of confirmation. However, this paper would like to highlight that acquired Piezo2 channelopathy is not a hypothesis anymore and carries such a significance that needs to be voiced, especially if we consider that it is theorized to be the primary damage, in line with the primary damage aging theory. Two years later after acquired Piezo2 channelopathy was theorized in 2021, the first research based direct verification of itsexistence came along in a neurogenetic disorder, called Angelman syndrome, followed by other direct and indirect research-based verifications that are introduced in this manuscript. However, Piezo2 function, consequently acquired Piezo2 channelopathy as well, is far from entirely known and still caries ample of mysteries, safeguarding the future potentials of the increasing trend of Piezo2-related research.
